name: council-isolated-two-round-smoke
decisionBrief:
DECISION: Choose the state boundary for a production authorization service.
OPTIONS: A) keep the current shared in-memory policy state and add synchronization B) replace it with an append-only policy event boundary
CONSTRAINTS: preserve the public API; one engineer has eight weeks; production traffic cannot stop; engineers other than the author will operate the result.
EVIDENCE: current shared-state implementation (code-read); three authorization incidents in the last quarter (measured: incident review); event-boundary performance claims (unverified-docs)
STAKES: a wrong boundary can either repeat authorization incidents or consume the only delivery window without shipping.
